questions.explain: The essential RDS metric set includes TransactionLogsDiskUsage, because the log-disk-full outage is the most preventable RDS incident, plus latency-focused I/O metrics, ReplicaLag, and FreeStorageSpace.
options: The log-disk-full prevention metric (TransactionLogsDiskUsage), I/O latency over IOPS, ReplicaLag, connections, and free storage
questions.q: Which metrics matter most for RDS for SQL Server, and why is TransactionLogsDiskUsage singled out?

questions.explain: Azure Monitor's killer feature is Query Store plus Intelligent Insights: the platform detects query regressions, timeouts, and resource exhaustion automatically and reports root causes in plain language.
options: Query Store + Intelligent Insights with automatic root-cause reporting
questions.q: What is Azure Monitor's 'killer feature' for SQL Server diagnostics?

questions.explain: Three dashboards per tier: health (availability, p95 latency, error rate, replication lag, backup age — the 'is it healthy' answer in five seconds), performance ('what's slow'), and capacity ('when do we act').
options: Health, performance, and capacity dashboards — one screen answering 'is it healthy' in five seconds
questions.q: What three dashboards should exist per database tier?

questions.explain: Page (availability down, failover, backup failed, log disk critical, replication lag beyond tolerance); ticket (sustained CPU, storage trending full, query regression, expiring cert); log (everything else, searchable, not notifying).
options: Page for availability/backup/lag failures, ticket for trending issues, log for the rest
Ticket for outages, page for informational events
questions.q: What is the chapter's alerting hierarchy?

questions.explain: Alert on symptoms and leading indicators (p95 latency above SLO), not raw counters (CPU above 80%); require duration (5 minutes, not one spike); give every alert a runbook link; review alert history monthly and kill or fix ignored alerts.
options: Alert on every raw counter immediately
Alert on symptoms and leading indicators with a duration requirement, attach a runbook to every alert, and review history monthly
Page on CPU above 80% for one spike
